cases.source: Live landscape case modeled on an observed maintainer session (2026-10-16) that answered 'none of the skills does this' after one generic search and a closed candidate list. The first version asked about idea-challenging skills; once this collection shipped critical-discussion, executors found it locally and the case stopped measuring the search, so the topic moved to instrumentation (2026-10-17). Mutable: repositories, catalogs and search indexes.
cases.rationale: Fitting skills exist under different names (observability, instrumentation, telemetry, OpenTelemetry or OTel, logging, tracing) and most cover only part of the request; the verification step sits inside one general skill, so a quick survey of the OpenTelemetry-specific ones invites a false 'nobody checks the telemetry arrives'. An absence claim needs varied terms, source families and a scope-bounded wording.

cases.source: Live web control for the landscape case; mutable source: the official documentation site.
cases.rationale: A documented absence is settled by the official module page; a landscape survey of third-party writers is waste. The coverage stop check may still add one note, which one line answers.
